user.title: Solar Sky
user.description: Pick the sensor that reports what your solar panels produce, and tell Solar Sky which way they face. If Forecast.Solar is set up, its plane is filled in for you.

data.backfill: Fill in past cloud cover from history

data_description.power_entity: Production of the panels in W or kW (not net grid power).
data_description.tilt: 0 = flat, 90 = vertical. Within about 10 degrees is enough.
data_description.azimuth: Compass direction the panels face: 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west.
data_description.temperature_entity: Improves accuracy a few percent (hot panels make less power).
data_description.weather_entity: Its cloud cover fills hours the panels can't see, and its wind moves the card's clouds if you have no wind sensors.
data_description.wind_direction_entity: Direction the wind comes from, in degrees.
data_description.wind_speed_entity: Moves the clouds in the sky card.
data_description.backfill: Uses the power sensor's long-term statistics to compute cloud cover for the past, so the card has history right away.

error.not_power: That sensor doesn't report power in W or kW.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already set up.

init.title: Solar Sky options
init.description: Changing tilt or azimuth rebuilds the learned table from the clear days stored so far.
